tei:div.tei:p: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: phag mo'i me mchod phrin las snang ba'i rgyan ces bya ba bzhugs so: dhī/: na mo gu ru dz+nyā na wā ra hī pā dā ya/ 'dir bsnyen pa las su rung ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ las sgrub pa me mchod kyi cho ga mdor bsdus te bya ba'i tshul la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po la gnyis/ cho gar ma gtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ cho gar gtogs pa'i sbyor ba dang*/ dang po ni/ gzhi ma dul ba yin na sa'i cho ga rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs par bya/ gang ltar yang rang gi mdun du shes pa'i sa las 'jam zhing khod snyoms pa'i stegs bu gru bzhi pa byas pa'i ngogs su rdul tshon gyis chos 'byung bsnol ma rdo ra me ri dang bcas pa'i lte bar pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i dbus su bam̐ yig rigs kyi kha dog can dang*/ 'dab ma la 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i srog gi mtshon byed ha ri ni sa'i yig 'bru bzhi dgod/ ma grub na me tog gi tshom bu'am/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor lta bur sol mes bkang ba'i snod bzhag kyang rung*/ thab kyi khar las gang gtso bor byed pa'i bud shing zlum po sogs dbyibs so sor brtsigs pa'am/ las bzhi'i shing dbyibs so sor phyogs bzhir brtsigs kyang rung zhing*/ de la shing ni zhi ba la bal bu/ lcang ma/ 'om bu sogs 'o ma can/ rgyas par star ga /shug pa sogs 'bras bu can mdog ser zhing dri bzang ba/ dbang la seng lding ngam/ 'o se/ mdzo mo shing sogs mdog dmar zhing ro skyur ba/ drag po la skyer pa sogs tsher ma can no/ /dbyibs zhi ba la zlum po/ rgyas pa la gru bzhi/ dbang la zla gam/ drag po la zur gsum du bya/ mchog gi dngos grub gtso bor byed pa la ni rgyas pa dang mthun/ der ma zad thab khung kyang zhi ba la dkar zlum khru gang*/ rgyas par gru bzhi ser po khru do/ dbang la zla gam dmar po khru gang*/ drag po la gru gsum nag po sor nyi shu/

dpangs su rang rang gi phyed cha/ sor bzhi'i mu ran dang kha khyer la zhi bar rdo rje dkar po/ rgyas par rin chen ser po/ dbang la lcags kyu dmar po/ drag po la gri gug nag po'i phreng bas bskor zhing*/ de'i lte bar chos 'byung sogs gong ltar bri/ de dang nye bar rang gi mdun du dgang blugs kha sbyar ba/ rdo dril/ thod rnga/ bsang chu me tog gi snod sogs dang*/ rang gi g.yas su sman gtor rak+ta nyer spyod tshogs kyi yo byad/ g.yon du sreg rdzas drag po la mchod sreg gi rdzas go ldog stai bsham/ mchan/ mar khu/ las mthun gyi yam shing*/ khyad par gyi rdzas sdig sgrib zhi ba dang bsnyen pa'i kha skong sogs la til bgegs zhi ba la yungs kar/ tshe rgyas pa la dūr+wa/ shes rab rgyas pa la dri bzang po dang ldan pa'i me tog ser po/ bsod nams rgyas pa la zas mchog /'byor pa rgyas pa la rin chen dar zab 'bru sna/ rigs brgyud rgyas pa la shing tog skyon med pa/ dbang la gar chang dang lan tshwas sbags pa'i me tog dmar po/ drag po la dug khrag dang liṅga/ mchog gi dngos grub gtso bor byed na bdud rtsi chos sman dang mā da na sin+dhū ra rnams bsres pa'i zas mchog bcas bsham/ spros pa la dga' na las so so dang mthun pa'i chas zhugs/ zhi ba la dar dang rin po che dkar po'i rgyan rgyas pa la ser/ dbang la dmar/ drag po la zhwa nag phod ka rus brgyan sogs/ mchan/ la blta phyogs zhi ba la shar/ rgyas pa la lho/ dbang la nub/ drag po la byang*/ 'dug stangs zhi ba la sems skyil/ rgyas pa la bzang po'i 'dug stangs/ dbang la pad skyil/ drag po la ru sbal gyi 'dug stangs/ sogs kyang spyi ltar ro/ gnyis pa ni/ skyabs sems nas bzung bzlas pa mchod bstod bar bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rigs bya/ bsang chu la dmigs te/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī hūm̐ phaṭa: ces bgegs bsang ba'i nus pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlab/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/

oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐ zhes pas rdo rje snying gar gsor/ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍai āḥs dril bu dkur brten/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ gis rdor dril bsnol ba'i 'khyud rgya dang bcas dam tshig gsum bzung*/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ thog mar mchod sreg gi rdzas rnams la bsang chu 'thor zhing*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bde chen gyi: rnam rol mchod dang bsreg bya'i rdzas: ye shes bdud rtsi 'dod yon sprin: cir yang 'char zhing 'byung bar gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan bdun dang*/ spro na nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas kyang brlab cing spel/ thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du dpal 'bar thogs la thab la g.yas su bskor zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra dz+nyā na ḍā ki nī dz+wa la ram̐: zhes lan gsum gyis me sbar/ ku sha'i 'thor yab kyis thab la bsang chu 'thor zhing*/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā bas sbyang*/ ā: 'od gsal stong nyid dbyings kyi mkha': thig le chen po'i klong yangs su: rig pa'i ye shes rang snang ba: las kyi dngos grub ji snyed kun: mos pa bzhin du 'byung ba'i gnas: mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs rdo rje'i thab: gos dkar yum gyi ngo bo nyid: rab 'bar me lce 'khyil ba'i dbus/ rigs kyis sa bon bam̐ yig las/ zhes pa'i mtshams phag mo rigs lnga so so'am dril sgrub gang byed ltar lha bskyed pa nas bzung mchod bstod bar rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa dang*/ thab kyi dbus su ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma la steng gi nam mkha' dang mtha' skor kun tu rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pas bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar las kyi dngos grub stsol ba la dgyes bzhin du bzhugs par gyur/ ces brjod cing gsal gdab/ dgang blugs thogs te/

oṃ āḥhūm̐: shes rab dgang gzar e yi dbyings: thabs mchog blugs gzar wam̐ yig gis: zung 'jug sreg rdzas bdud rtsir bskyil: byang chub sems kyi mchod pa'i sprin: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du thim: zag med bde bas rab mnyes pa'i: ye shes chen po'i 'od zer gyis: las kyi dngos grub mchog stsol gyur: ces brjod cing dmigs la/ lha sngags gang yin lan bdun dang*/ mar blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar kha sbyar nas thabs la bskor zhing 'bul te/ spel tshig zhi ba spyir/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: rgyas par tshe bsod dpal 'byor ye shes yon tan sogs mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa thams cad puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ: dbang la/ gsum gsum brtan g.yo'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad wā shaṃ ku ru ho: drag po la/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya pha¿ṭa: mchog la/ sa dang lam gyi nyams rtogs yon tan ye shes thams cad puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ: zhes gdags/ bye brag gi spel tshig rnams 'og tu shes de lta bus mar khu nyer gcig dang*/ yam shing de mtshungs phul/ de nas las so so'i khyad par gyi rdzas lha sngags brgya sogs kyi mtshams su spel tshig gdags pa la grangs bzung*/ de rnams kyi tshe/ thab kyi lha tshogs rnams kyis 'od zer dkar po zla ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can spro ba dang bsdu ba'i sgo nas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad pa de bzhin du 'od zer ser po gser zhun ma'i mdangs can nyi ma 'char kha'i gzi byin lta bus tshe bsod sogs rgyas pa/ 'od zer dmar po pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs can lcags kyu'i rnam pas dbang*/ 'od zer mthing nag tsha zhing rtsub pa mtshon cha dang nad mtshon dug gi char 'bebs pas drag po/ 'od zer dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa dran pa tsam gyis bde stong gi ye shes skyed pa spro bsdus mchog gi las thams cad rtsol med du 'grub par bsams la dmigs pa'i gsal snang la rtse gcig tu sems 'dzin pa ni rno la ngar gyis gdags pa bzhin no/

gsum pa rjes ni/ grangs rdzogs pa'i tshe spro na/ oṃ badz+ra wās+t+ra ya swā hā sa las mthun gyi gos zung dang*/ oṃ badz+ra tam+bu lā ya swā hā' sa so rtsi 'bul/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ rang byung pad+ma bhañja sogs kyis tshogs brlab/ hrīḥ ngo bo chos sku'i sogs kyis tshogs phud thams cad kyi dkyil dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ pheṃ pheṃ: bh+yoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sogs kyis lhag ma thab kyi zur du dbul/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sogs smon lam gdab/ spro zhing nus na nang dang gsang ba'i tshogs mchod kyang ji ltar rigs pa bgyis pas nang gsang gi sbyin sreg kyang zhar la grub pa yin gang ltar yang gtang rag gi mchod bstod sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra dz+nyā na ḍā ki nī sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ gis dngos grub blang*/ yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bshags/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs thab kyi ye shes pa rang la thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra dz+nyā na dhā ka nī āt+ma ko3haṃḥzhes nga rgyal gzung*/ dam tshig pa me 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur ces brjod cing bsams la/ hoḥ bde chen byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du: zag med bdud rtsi'i sreg blugs phul ba'i mthus: bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus kun: rdo rje btsun mo'i go 'phang myur thob shog: ces bsngo smon dang*/ oṃ: dgongs brda snyan brgyud rig rtsal 'chang : rig 'dzin bla ma'i bkra shis shog: rab 'byams zhi khro'i phyag rgyar snang : yi dam lha yi bkra shis shog: rnal 'byor grogs mdzad bde chen spel: phyi nang mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis shog: legs nyes stangs 'dzin bar chad sel: chos srung rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: gnas skabs rnam bzhi'i phrin las kyis: don gnyis mthar phyin bkra shis shog: mthar thug 'chi med ye shes sku: mngon sum 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: ces sogs shis pa brjod pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang bcas me tog gi char dbab/ thal ba zhi rgyas dbang gsum la me rang zhir 'jog pa'am/

long med na zhi ba la 'o ma/ rgyas pa la dri ser po/ dbang la chang dang sbyar ba'i chus gzhil zhing*/ drag po ni dug khrag gi chus cig car du gzhil te zhi ba'i thal ba chu klung chen por sbyang*/ rgyas par mdzod kyi phug tu sba/ dbang la ri mthon pa'i rtser mthun pa'i rlung la bskur/ drag po la lam gyi gzhi mdor mnan pas mtshon las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /'phros don bye brag gi spel tshig ni/ bsnyen pa sogs kyi kha skong la/ gsang sngags kyi lhag chad sogs bzlas pa'i nyes skyon thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: dam tshig nyams chag zhi bar/ dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad thams cad shan+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: tshe rgyas pa la/ tshe phun sum tshogs pa thams cad puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ: de bzhin du shes rab phun sum tshogs pa thams cad puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ: bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa thams cad puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ: 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ: chos dang rigs kyi brgyud 'dzin phun sum tshogs pa thams cad puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ: zhes sogs gang 'dod dang*/ dbang gi las dmigs bsal la/ khams gsum skye dgu'i bla yid wā shaṃ ku ru ho: zhes sam yang na ming 'di zhes bya ba'i bla yid sogs spel lo/ /spyir phag mo rigs gang la brten kyang las thams cad bsgrub tu rung mod/ gtso bor phag mo dkar mos zhi ba/ ser mos rgyas pa/ dmar mos dbang*/ ljang mos drag po/ nag mos mchog gi las la sbyar ba legs shing*/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la/ skyabs sems tsam gyi rjes/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje phag mo'i skur gyur par mos la bsang chu dang mchod sreg gi rdzas brlab/ aḥ 'od gsal stong nyid dbyings kyi mkha': zhes sogs gong ltar la/ dgang blugs ma 'byor na lag gnyis rdo rje'i dgang blugs su mos te/ mar khu phud skyogs sogs kyis blugs kyang rung zhing*/ spyir mar dang yam shing sogs ma 'byor kyang*/

phye mar dang*/ 'bru sman rin chen shing tog dar zab sogs gang 'byor sbom rdzas su byas nas/ oṃ āḥ hūm̐: thabs dang shes rab dbyer med pa'i: byang chub sems kyi mchod pa'i sprin: ces sogs gsal btab la phul bas kyang rung ste/ nyang gter phag mo'i me mchod las/ rdzas ni phye mar rat+na sman: zas ni rnam pa sna tshogs dang : rin po che dang 'bru sna dang : dar zab gos la sogs pa bsreg: ces dang*/ bla ma gsang ba 'dus pa las: tshogs gsog pa yi sbyin sreg ni: phyi dang sman gyis 'grub pa'o: zas 'dod pa la zas de bsreg: gos 'dod pa la gos de bsreg: nang nub thab tu bsreg kyang chog: ces sogs tshad mar gyur pa'i gzhung gzhan las kyang 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /rdzas rdzogs pa na mchod bstod nongs bshags sogs gong ltar bya'o/ /yang tshogs mchod dang 'brel bar me mchod 'bul bar spro na/ phy-i'i tshogs mchod kyi rjes su bsang chu byin gyis brlabs pa nas bzung cho ga rgyas bsdus gang rigs bya/ tshogs kyi mchod pa phud kyi cha shas sngags tsam gyis phul bas rung*/ mthar me lha rang la bstims pa'i bar gyi rjes nang dang gsang ba'i tshogs mchod sogs dkyus ltar byas pas rung ngo*/ /zhes pa'ang gzhung rtsa ba la phyag len rgyas par phye ste bklags pas grub par mtsho skyes bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rjes sbyar ba'i dge bas 'gro kun dngos grub rnam pa gnyis kyi dga' ston la 'dod rgur spyod pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba dā shre yo bha ba tu// //
